spans.s: A lunar mansion; a star; इन्दुप्रकाशान्तरितोडुतुल्याः
Water (said to be n. only). -Comp. -गणाधिपः The moon. ˚पं The constellation मृगशिरस्. -चक्रम् zodiacal circle. -पः, -पम्, [उडुनि जले पाति]
A kind of drinking vessel covered with leather; comm. on
Varuṇa, regent of waters. -पथः the sky, the firmament.
उडुम्बरः [uḍumbarḥ], 1 N. of a tree; Ficus Glomearata (Mar. औदुम्बर).
The threshold of a house. उच्छ्रायात् पादविस्तीर्णा शाखा तद्वदुदुम्बरः Bṛi.
A kind of leprosy with copper spots (-रम् also).
A kind of worm said to be produced in the blood and to cause leprosy.
रम् The fruit of the उदुम्बर tree.
A Karṣa, a measure of two tolās. -Comp. -दला, -पर्णी the plant Croton Polyandra (दन्ती).
उडूपः [uḍūpḥ], = उडुपः q. v. -प्रिया A lotus-creeper.
